scope: Current four PBMC training groups, selected and retained-near fits, current CPA2560 continuation, supplied replay boundaries. Other named study components retain their own complete source manifests.

submission.route: Extract Supporting_Reconstruction.zip and Code_Reproducibility.zip as sibling directories.

training_study.route: Request the current PBMC training assets from the corresponding author; identify files with this manifest. No public archive URL has been assigned.
training_study.source_code_access: The code/protocol subset is supplied in confidential current_native_sources.zip; this does not supply model, training-array or bank assets.

cpa_continuation.route: Request the six 1280-to-2560 continuation records and model artifacts from the corresponding author. Source Data supplies their derived results.
cpa_continuation.source_code_access: The code/protocol subset is supplied in confidential current_native_sources.zip; this does not supply model, training-array or bank assets.

provider_influenza.route: Raw study accession GSE162632: https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/geo/query/acc.cgi?acc=GSE162632 . Exact processed inputs, cell selections and feature/scaling records require the hash-bound author-prepared assets.

provider_parse.route: https://www.parsebiosciences.com/datasets/10-million-human-pbmcs-in-a-single-experiment/ . Observe the source CC BY-NC 4.0 terms. Exact processed inputs require the hash-bound author-prepared assets.

evaluation_workspace.route: Request the specified fixed-prediction arrays and receipts from the corresponding author, or regenerate them from authenticated models and registered controls.

project_archive.route: Request the individually named source, allocation and preprocessing records. This root is a portable namespace, not a promise that the full author workspace is distributed.
project_archive.source_code_access: The code/protocol subset is supplied in confidential current_native_sources.zip; this does not supply model, training-array or bank assets.

scGen.objective: official scGen loss with recorded mean-one stratum weights

CPA.scheduler: StepLR advanced once per epoch, step_size45 gamma0.9
CPA.objective: native NB reconstruction with mean-one stratum weights; native adversarial regularizers

CellOT.checkpoint_selection: one representation and outer-step budget per resource/regime across all tasks and validation donors
CellOT.AE: official plain scRNA AutoEncoder, latent50, two512 hidden layers; training-fold internal cell holdout for reconstruction checkpoint selection, then freeze encoder/decoder before OT validation
CellOT.batched_map_optimization: allowed only after equivalence tests against independent native maps; no shared transport parameters

selection.criterion: minimum complete equal-donor primary validation risk
selection.tie_rule: smaller training budget, then smaller representation rank, then lexicographic candidate identifier
selection.near_optimal_sensitivity: retain one additional distinct setting within1percent of minimum if available, ordered by risk then tie rule

upstream_access: Author archival presence is verified separately and is not reviewer access. No new public checkpoint archive or raw-data download is claimed.
full_training_portability: Native trainer and evaluator inputs retain historical nested provenance. The supplied checker resolves file assets by named roots; it does not rewrite original metadata or make the complete scheduler workflow portable.

additional_artifacts.scope: 26 unmodified custom source, protocol and allocation records; no model weights, prepared expression or prediction banks
additional_artifacts.access: Confidential submission attachment; not part of the public GitHub repository
additional_artifacts.historical_provenance: Original metadata retains author locations and donor/capture identifiers; these are not reviewer access endpoints
additional_artifacts.license_scope: Original component terms; no blanket BSD license for mixed code/protocol/allocation metadata
